card.title: Properly Initiated
card.instruction: Treat correct participation in the ritual as proof you deserve to belong. Watch for cues, copy the form, and overcommit to every step.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: My first club dinner. I've learnt the toast so nobody regrets voting me in.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Stand and lift your glass with mine. We sit when the chair sits.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Same height as yours? I want to get this right.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Any height. I have to sit; my knee's giving out.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lean on me. I'll keep us both standing until the chair sits. I won't let my first toast fall short.

mechanism: A seeks membership legitimacy through exact toast form and overcommits by physically supporting B to stand until the chair does.
confusable: Unlike controlling the ritual for authority, A fears personally falling short of the participation that justified admission.
comparison: The dinner alternative prolongs standing despite a knee problem; the choir alternative adds a shoe action to finish bows together.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
